Tree View & List View Controls
TreeView: • Structure: Displays hierarchical, nested TreeNodes. • Nodes: Adds parent and child items (Nodes.Add()). • SelectedNode: Gets the active clicked node.
ListView: • Structure: Displays tabular rows/columns or icons. • View: Toggles Details, List, or Icon modes. • SubItems: Stores data for additional columns.
Primary Uses: • TreeView: Directories, category hierarchies. • ListView: File listings, tabular data grids.
